speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me, besides the fatigue, bruising, fever, and severe leg pain you mentioned, have you noticed any bleeding from your gums, nose, or urine? Also, what is your age?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL). The combination of prolonged fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe bone pain (especially at night) in a 4-year-old is highly characteristic of ALL. Immediate blood work is required.

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_Differential_and_Peripheral_Smear.
